Title: searchQuestions forwards every filter as query params including pagination and skill ids
PreConditions: apiClient.get mocked to resolve a success envelope
Steps: Call searchQuestions with a full SearchParams object
Expected: GET /api/v1/question-bank/questions/search with the whole object as params

Title: updateQuestion strips the uid out of the PATCH body
PreConditions: apiClient.patch mocked to resolve a success envelope
Steps: Call updateQuestion with a full UpdateQuestionDto
Expected: PATCH /api/v1/question-bank/questions/q-1 with a body that has no uid key

Title: deleteQuestion soft-deletes through the question URL and resolves the envelope
PreConditions: apiClient.delete mocked to resolve a success envelope with data null
Expected: DELETE /api/v1/question-bank/questions/q-1 and the promise resolves to null rather than rejecting

Title: A failed search maps to an ApiError carrying the backend message
PreConditions: apiClient.get mocked to reject with an axios error carrying a response
TestData: status=400; body.message='Không tìm thấy chủ đề'; body.traceId='tr-400'
Expected: ApiError with message=body message and status=400

Title: Each of the five domain difficulty levels passes through to the search params unchanged
PreConditions: apiClient.get mocked to resolve a success envelope
TestData: difficulty in [very_easy, easy, medium, hard, very_hard]
Expected: params.difficulty equals the value that was passed in every time

Title: The idle prompt is replaced by the result count and one card per question
PreConditions: Topics read resolved; search read resolved with two questions
Steps: Render QuestionBankPage; type a query; click Search
Expected: Idle block gone; results block shows the count 2 and both question texts

Title: A failed search shows the search-failed alert and no results block
PreConditions: Topics read resolved; search read rejects
Steps: Render QuestionBankPage; type a query; click Search
TestData: ApiError('Cổng câu hỏi không sẵn sàng',503)
Expected: Alert 'Search failed. Please try again.'; no results block and no 'no questions found' block

Title: The create-form toggle swaps the search panel for the form and back
PreConditions: Topics read resolved; no search issued yet
Steps: Render QuestionBankPage; click '+ Create Question'; click Cancel
Expected: Form block and its 'Create New Question' heading appear with the search input and idle prompt gone; the toggle label becomes Cancel; clicking it restores the search panel

Title: The loading block shows during an in-flight search and is replaced by the no-questions block
PreConditions: Topics read resolved; search read deferred then resolved with an empty page
Steps: Render QuestionBankPage; type a query; click Search; resolve the search
Expected: Loading block visible and the idle prompt gone while the request is open; then the no-questions block with 'No questions found', the loading block gone and the result count reading 0
